title: English Practice Quiz 0953
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A form should be completed using information that is ___.
The abbreviation 'N/A' commonly means ___.
questions.explanation: N/A indicates that a field does not apply.

questions.question: A document's reference number helps staff ___.
questions.explanation: Reference numbers make records easier to track.

questions.question: A signed attendance sheet is used to record ___.
questions.explanation: An attendance sheet records participants or staff who were present.

questions.question: When correcting a paper record, staff should follow ___.
options: a method that hides the original entry
questions.explanation: An authorised method preserves record integrity and traceability.

questions.question: A document's issue date tells the reader when it was ___.
questions.explanation: The issue date identifies when the document was released.

questions.question: A 'certified copy' is a copy whose accuracy has been ___.
options: formally confirmed by an authorised person
questions.explanation: Certification confirms that the copy matches the original, according to the applicable process.

questions.question: A register is commonly used to ___.
options: maintain an organised record of entries
questions.explanation: A register is a structured record of information or events.

questions.question: Before archiving a file, check its ___.
questions.explanation: Retention rules and completeness matter when storing records.

questions.question: A document marked 'confidential' should be handled ___.
options: according to access and security rules
questions.explanation: Confidential material requires controlled handling and access.
